title: Toddler Jim with Easter Basket, Backyard - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Jim looking at his Easter eggs.
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot of a young toddler named Jim standing on the backyard lawn during an Easter egg hunt. He wears a light-colored newsboy-style cap, shorts, long-sleeved shirt, socks, and white shoes, inspecting eggs held in his hands. An Easter basket filled with collected eggs sits in the grass beside him. In the background, a residential bungalow or craftsman-style house, a white picket fence, and a wooden T-post clothesline define a typical early-to-mid 20th-century suburban American yard.
